[QUERY] Did the peripheral blood smear show any blasts or immature precursor cells (eg, myelocytes, promyelocytes, metamyelocytes) or was it completely normal?

[TEST] Order peripheral blood flow cytometry (immunophenotyping) to identify and quantify blasts and determine lineage (myeloid vs lymphoid) and relevant markers.

This constellation is the single most likely diagnosis.

[DIAGNOSIS] Precursor B‑cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B‑ALL).
